Gligar

Ground Flying

Johto · Generation 2

Gligar is a Ground/Flying-type Fly Scorpion Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.1 m tall and weighs 64.8 kg. It evolves into Gliscor. Its highest base stat is Defense (105), with a base stat total of 430.
